description: HTTP Tracking API JSON on the data plane, and Pixel API GET /pixel/v1/track. Self-hosted data planes on other hosts are directory-only.

params.name: writeKey
params.description: The Pixel API authenticates with the source write key in the query. HTTP POST uses basic auth instead, and is a JSON artifact.
params.fix_hint: Add `writeKey` from the HTTP source in the dashboard.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the event being tracked. Required on /pixel/v1/track.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Viewed`.

params.name: anonymousId
params.description: Anonymous identifier. The Pixel API requires `userId` or `anonymousId`.

params.name: userId
params.description: Known-user identifier. Alternative to `anonymousId`.

params.name: name
params.description: Page or screen name sent for context on a pixel track.

params.name: context.library.name
params.description: Name of the library or SDK, such as `Rudderstack AMP SDK`.

params.name: context.library.version
params.description: Version of the library or SDK.

params.name: context.platform
params.description: Platform context, such as `AMP`.

params.name: context.locale
params.description: User locale, such as the browser language.

params.name: context.userAgent
params.description: User agent string of the client that fired the pixel.

params.name: context.screen.width
params.description: Screen width in pixels. RudderStack's Pixel API sample sends an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send the width in pixels, such as `1920`.

params.name: context.screen.height
params.description: Screen height in pixels. RudderStack's Pixel API sample sends an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send the height in pixels, such as `1080`.

params.name: context.page.path
params.description: Path of the page being viewed.

params.name: context.page.url
params.description: Full page URL. RudderStack documents `path`, `url`, `referrer`, and `title` on `context.page`.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `context.page.url`, including the scheme.

params.name: context.page.referrer
params.description: Referrer URL of the page being viewed.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute referrer URL, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: context.page.title
params.description: Title of the page being viewed.

rules.message: The pixel has neither `userId` nor `anonymousId`. RudderStack documents one of the two as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `userId` for a known user, or `anonymousId` for an unidentified one.

params.name: type
params.description: Each batched call names a documented method.
params.fix_hint: Set `type` to identify, track, page, screen, group, or alias.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the user action. Required on a track call.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Purchased`.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the group. RudderStack documents it as required on a group call.
params.fix_hint: Set `groupId` to the group in your database.

params.name: previousId
params.description: The previous unique identifier of the user. RudderStack documents it on an alias call.
params.fix_hint: Set `previousId` to the id being merged.

rules.message: A `track` call carries no `event`. RudderStack documents the event name as required.
rules.fix_hint: Add the event name to the call.

rules.message: A `group` call carries no `groupId`. RudderStack documents the group id as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `groupId` to the group in your database.

rules.message: An `alias` call carries no `previousId`. RudderStack documents the previous unique identifier on alias.
rules.fix_hint: Set `previousId` to the id being merged.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the user action. Required on a track call.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Purchased`.

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique identifier for the user. Either this or `anonymousId` is required.

params.name: anonymousId
params.description: Stands in for a user id when there is none. Either this or `userId` is required.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: RudderStack documents timestamp as ISO 8601 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp such as `2022-02-01T19:14:18.381Z`.

params.name: sentAt
params.description: RudderStack documents `sentAt` as the client send time, used with `anonymousId` to keep event order.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp such as `2022-02-01T19:14:18.381Z`.

params.name: context.ip
params.description: It is the visitor IP, sent unhashed. RudderStack's HTTP samples send a raw address.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the page or screen. RudderStack's HTTP page and screen samples send it.

params.name: context.library.name
params.description: Name of the library that produced the call. RudderStack's HTTP samples send `http`.

params.name: properties.revenue
params.description: Amount associated with the event. RudderStack's HTTP track sample sends a decimal number such as `4.99`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `4.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: properties.path
params.description: Path of the page being viewed. RudderStack's HTTP page sample sends it on `properties`.

params.name: properties.title
params.description: Title of the page being viewed. RudderStack's HTTP page sample sends it on `properties`.

rules.message: The call carries neither `userId` nor `anonymousId`. RudderStack documents one of the two as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `userId` for a known user, or `anonymousId` for an unidentified one.

rules.message: `context.ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but RudderStack documents it as an IP address.
